Continue with Example 2.5(2), and suppose now that our category $\mathscr{C}$ of finite-dimensional $M$ -graded $\mathbf{k}$ -vector spaces is endowed with a tensor product $\otimes$. There is then a law $*$ on $M$ such that

$\mathbf{k}[m]\otimes\mathbf{k}[n]=\mathbf{k}[m*n]$

for all $m,n\in M$ (where $\mathbf{k}[p]$ means $\mathbf{k}$ placed in degree $p$ ). The constraints (1) in the theorem impose that $M$ is a commutative monoid, and then $B=\mathbf{k}M$ is the associated monoid algebra. paper.title: Notes on the geometric Satake equivalence
paper.abstract: These notes are devoted to a detailed exposition of the proof of the Geometric Satake Equivalence for general coefficients, following Mirkovic-Vilonen.
